theorems.name: Submission.cmc_local_comparison_inequality
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsMinimizingIn (Ts j) U) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + (Ts j).boundary.massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → ∀ (K : Set (Euclid P)) (ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → 0 < ε → ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ W ⊆ thickening ε K ∧ CompactlyContained W U ∧ ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞), StrictMono φ ∧ Tendsto e atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ ∀ S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → S.boundary = T.boundary → (S - T).support ⊆ K → ∀ j, (Ts (φ j)).massOn W ≤ S.massOn W + e j
